title: doToggle uses raw picklist ints `100000007`/`100000008` instead of AuditActionType enum names
detail: Line 150: `actionType: newActive ? 100000007 : 100000008, // Template Activated / Deactivated`. The magic numbers are AuditActionType.Created (100000007) and AuditActionType.Deleted (100000008) per portalApi.js:96, but the labels 'Template Activated/Deactivated' don't match Created/Deleted. Either the enum is wrong (then we need new values) or the usage is wrong (should reuse StatusChanged = 100000006). Cat 11 handoff cleanliness.
recommendedFix: Replace with `actionType: AuditActionType.StatusChanged` â€” template activation is a status change, not a create/delete. Drop the raw ints. If business needs distinct audit types for activation, add `TemplateActivated`/`TemplateDeactivated` values to AuditActionType with new picklist values.
